key_findings: Chronic restraint stress increased activity of amygdala GABAergic neurons projecting to the parafascicular thalamus and reduced BDNF expression in mice.
Salvianolic acid B relieved depression-like behavior and lowered pain thresholds via ERK-CREB-BDNF signaling, effects blocked by a pathway antagonist.
